title: O, How I Love Jesus
lyrics: [G]There is a Name I love to hear, I [D]love to sing its [G]worth;
[G]It sounds like music in my ears, The [Am]sweetest [G]Name [D7]on [G]earth.
[G]O how I love Jesus, [D]O how I love [G]Jesus,
There [G]is a name I love to hear, I [D]love to sing its [G]worth[D];
It [G]sounds like music [Em]in my ear, The [Am]sweetest [D7]name on [G]earth.
[G]Oh, how I love Jesus, [D]Oh, how I love [G]Jesus,
It tells me of a Savior's love, Who died to set me free;
It tells me of a Savior's blood, The sinners' perfect plea.
It tells of one whose loving heart Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in each sorrow bears A part that none can bear below.
